invariants.rationale: The method always returns the object created by HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create(), which should not return null under normal operation.
The method operates on keyToNewRecords and passes it to HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create; it is expected to be non-null at this point.
partitionPath is a fundamental identifier for the operation and must be non-null and non-empty for correct behavior.
fileId is used to identify the file being updated and must be non-null and non-empty.
dataFileToBeMerged represents the base file to merge into and is required for the merge; it should not be null.
